predictions.rationale: Defines the core abstraction for a Design Critic agent, including trigger conditions, evaluation logic, and the generation of ToDo items.
Central manager that keeps the set of active Critic instances and coordinates their execution over the model, embodying the background "agents" concept.
Implements the scheduling/execution mechanism that repeatedly invokes critics in a background thread, directly enabling continuous analysis.
Default implementation of ControlMech used by Agency; contains the concrete run-loop that drives critics and posts their findings.
Application-level initializer that launches the critic background thread at startup, wiring the critic subsystem into ArgoUML.
Represents an individual suggestion or warning produced by a critic; core data object displayed to the designer.
Aggregates the ToDoItem objects generated by critics, providing the main data structure powering the "design issues" UI.
Registers and configures the full set of UML-specific critic subclasses with the Agency, making them active in the system.
Supports combining multiple basic critics into a single higher-level critic, extending the critic framework’s capabilities.
UI action that enables or disables the automatic background critique process, directly controlling the feature’s runtime behavior.
